page.notes: Three columns of the index, running from "tibus" to "moses promulgator", all in alphabetical order under the letters M. The first column begins mid-entry ("tibus"), so its first line is a fragment. Several Greek words are printed in the index and are transcribed approximately. Some entries at the right edge and at the foot of the page are partly obscured or cut off, and one line of the last column is incomplete on the scan. A few numbers are doubtful, e.g. "15.582", "413" and "424". A dot-leader mark appears beside "morte christi cœli aperti". Reading the numbers at the top of the columns is uncertain.
